_: Env values that MUST survive a release cutover, with the evidence for each.
A release dir gets a REAL .env file, not a symlink, so a cutover that forgets to carry these
forward silently reverts them to code defaults. That is not hypothetical: the 36h hold policy
was lost exactly this way once (2026-08-05), and nothing failed loudly when it happened.
'shared' applies identically to TESTNET and LIVE for this versioned strategy.
Instance-specific values belong in 'instances.<id>.extra' only when they cannot alter strategy
formation, sizing, risk, or exit behavior. This rollout intentionally has no such divergence.
Apply or verify with deploy/apply-required-env.sh. Run --check after EVERY cutover.
Values here are per-lane policy, never secrets — API keys stay out of version control.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_EXEC_MAX_HOLD_HOURS.why: +35% return per unit of slot time at statistically identical per-basket return. Lost in a release cutover on 2026-08-05; this file exists because of it.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_EXEC_STOP_NET_RETURN.why: No new-basket stop. Canonical continuation research keeps NoTP/Hold as the comparator; a stop challenger has not passed robust temporal OOS. Existing pre-cutover baskets keep their separately pinned legacy stop.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_EXEC_TP_NET_RETURN.why: Retained only as an explicit dormant numeric value. TP is disabled by the separate boolean; deleting this key would silently revive the 0.60% default if that boolean ever drifted.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_EXEC_TP_DISABLED.why: Dynamic MOM36 never uses an ordinary TP. The numeric value remains explicitly present only so a future flag drift cannot silently revive the default TP. Existing baskets use their frozen or legacy contract.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_SMART_BASKET_V1.why: Lifecycle guard only: keeps entry revalidation, provenance, and ghost telemetry available for FILTERED baskets. It must not select symbols or enable utility reranking; that is controlled solely by CROSS_SECTIONAL_SMART_FORMATION_RERANK below.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_SMART_INVALIDATION_SCANS.why: Disables all three Smart Basket exits by making them arithmetically unreachable - a 48h horizon yields at most 48 hourly scans. Measured 2026-08-19 on 362 blocks x 24 offsets: the deployed REGIME+CONTEXT pair cost -0.2382pp/basket and lost in 24 of 24 offsets (median t -2.84), turning a +0.14%/basket lane into -0.11%. cross-sectional-edge.ts never reads this key, so Formation is untouched.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_SMART_REGIME_LOSS_EXIT.why: Second, explicit layer over the scans threshold. Its own measurement is the weakest of the three (proxy regime classifier, sign-flips out-of-sample), but it contributes to the pair via first-to-fire truncation.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_ADAPTIVE_EXITS_ENABLED.why: Adaptive exits remain OFF in production. Ghost observation continues, but regime/context/MFE may not send an order until a challenger passes robust forward evidence.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_K.why: Legacy admission probe geometry only. Dynamic MOM36 itself freezes one of 6L0S through 0L6S after breadth, always six total legs.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_HORIZON_BARS.why: Measurement horizon remains 48h; execution cap is separately 36h and must never be confused with this research label.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_FILTERED_MIN_SCORE_GAP.why: Formation admission gate: long-short separation floor. The code default 0.02 is inert (rejects ~0.2% of baskets). At 0.058 across 48 offsets, mean/basket rises monotonically 0.1634% -> 0.2394%, max drawdown falls -54.47% -> -44.03%, and it improves BOTH out-of-sample halves - turning the losing half from -6.92% to +4.79%. Absolute MOM36 strength and dispersion were tested as alternative gates and have no gradient.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_FILTERED_MAX_PER_CLUSTER.why: Concentration guardrail only; it is not claimed as an alpha source.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_FILTERED_WEIGHTING.why: Preserved for the existing production admission probe and legacy baskets. Dynamic MOM36 final selection is always six equal $25 legs.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_EDGE_MAX_STORED_OBSERVAT.why: Depth of the IN-APP shadow reports only. History no longer depends on it: deploy/archive-observations.py harvests every resolved observation into an append-only JSONL (~15MB/yr/instance, never pruned) so the cap can no longer silently decide what survives. 15000 keeps the store ~24MB, an order of magnitude below the 234MB that once made testnet unresponsive; it is now a free knob rather than a load-bearing one.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_SMART_FORMATION_RERANK.why: Smart Formation's utility re-ranking (fastSupport, adverseExtension, counter-axis, cluster penalty) OFF. Ablation over 12 block offsets across two years: full re-ranking +0.2227%/basket vs +0.2220% for plain MOM36 rank — 0.0007pp, with identical PF, hit rate, quarterly stability and worst quarter. The hard cluster cap stays as a concentration guardrail; entry revalidation and ghost use the frozen selected-leg data without running utility rerank.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_SYMBOL_RELIABILITY_ENABL.why: Reliability V1 is the only side-specific eligibility circuit breaker in this policy. It may quarantine only a symbol+side after two evidence-changing actual NoTP+Hold36h independent-episode evaluations; HEALTHY, DEGRADED, and INSUFFICIENT_DATA never alter Plain MOM36 selection. Pinning the explicit enable flag prevents a future release directory from silently reverting the deployed observer/gate to its safe code default OFF.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_MAKER_EXIT_ENABLED.why: Preserves the current market-exit runtime behaviour. Dynamic MOM36's scheduled horizon and every exceptional/manual exit use the established immediate market/reconciliation path.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_MAKER_EXIT_WAIT_MS.why: How long the reduce-only post-only exit rests before it is cancelled and the remainder crosses. Bounded 1s-120s in code.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_LEGACY_EXEC_MAX_HOLD_HOU.why: Exit contract retained for an already-open pre-cutover basket that has no policy fingerprint.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_LEGACY_EXEC_STOP_NET_RET.why: The current pre-cutover executor reports no ordinary stop. This fallback is used only for a historical row without a frozen policy fingerprint; it does not alter a new Dynamic basket.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_LEGACY_EXEC_TP_NET_RETUR.why: Pre-cutover TP retained only for rows with no policy fingerprint; it does not alter a new basket.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_LEGACY_EXEC_TP_DISABLED.why: Pre-cutover TP was enabled; keeping it explicit prevents a new release from rewriting an existing basket's exit contract.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_LEGACY_MAKER_EXIT_ENABLE.why: Maker exit did not exist in the pre-cutover runtime, so an existing basket remains on its original market-exit contract.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_LEGACY_ADAPTIVE_EXITS_EN.why: Pre-cutover adaptive exits were operationally disabled; legacy rows preserve that behavior.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_LEGACY_EXEC_LEG_USD.why: Pre-cutover sizing fallback for a persisted basket whose old fingerprint lacks sizing fields. It prevents the Dynamic 1x contract from rewriting an old basket.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_LEGACY_EXEC_LEVERAGE.why: Observed pre-cutover basket leverage. Used only when a legacy fingerprint did not store leverage.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_LEGACY_EXEC_MAX_OPEN_BAS.why: Observed pre-cutover slot limit retained for legacy compatibility.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_EXEC_TICK_MS.why: Executor tick. Was a hardcoded 5 minutes, so a fresh signal waited ~150s on average before anything looked at it — measured end to end at 239.8s live / 229.9s testnet, almost all of it this interval. No gate is weakened by being asked sooner; the tick is idempotent and single-flighted. Bounded 15s-5m in code.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_EXEC_FORCE_IGNORE_ENTRY_.why: Dynamic MOM36 uses its versioned admission path directly. Pin the legacy bypass OFF in both environments so testnet/live configuration stays strategy-identical and an old testnet override cannot silently leak into reporting.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_ENTRY_TRAFFIC_LIGHT.why: The Dynamic policy freezes six equal $25 legs and has no confidence-sized learning tier. Keep the old traffic-light scaler OFF in both environments.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_POLICY_VERSION.why: Immutable policy identity for the Dynamic MOM36 36h rollout. New evidence must never be mixed with the prior full-TP policy.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_CURRENT_POLICY_FORWARD_S.why: Forward-cohort boundary for Dynamic MOM36. It is set to the release cutover timestamp and does not reclassify prior baskets.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_STRATEGY_VERSION.why: Selects the versioned Dynamic MOM36 formation and exit dispatcher for new baskets only.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_STRATEGY_DEPLOYED_AT.why: Frozen strategy deployment timestamp captured in every new basket fingerprint.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_EXEC_VARIANT.why: Makes the intended execution variant explicit even though app wiring also pins the Dynamic target variant.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_EXEC_LEG_USD.why: Six fixed equal-notional legs: every Dynamic basket is exactly $150 gross before exchange rounding.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_EXEC_LEVERAGE.why: Dynamic MOM36 invariant: no leverage increase or confidence scaling.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_EXEC_MAX_OPEN_BASKETS.why: Global Dynamic slot limit: an existing cross basket blocks a new portfolio.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_REGIME_SKEW_ENABLED.why: Legacy regime skew cannot modify Dynamic MOM36 breadth allocation.
